name: xtraCHEF by Toast
oneLiner: Toast's back-office tool for invoice automation, recipe costing and inventory, tying supplier costs to Toast POS sales data.
bestFor: Restaurants already on Toast POS that want to stop keying invoices and track food cost and recipe margins.
features: Invoice automation: capture supplier invoices and extract line-item costs
Recipe and menu costing with prep/sub-recipes, yields and unit conversions (Pro)
Vendor management, ordering and product catalogs
Uses Toast POS sales data to connect costs to what sold
Accounting integrations for invoice and cost data

pricing.text: Toast does not publish xtraCHEF prices; sold in Essentials and Pro tiers through Toast sales. Invoice automation is in both tiers, recipe costing and inventory only in Pro.

notes: Acquired by Toast in 2021; still sold as 'xtraCHEF by Toast' (no rebrand found). No dated 2025 or 2026 xtraCHEF announcement found; a '10.4' release with an Inventory by COGS report and recipe variance prime-cost breakdown is mentioned on xtrachef.com/resources but undated. No named customers found (search budget ran out before a customer search). Third-party price estimates ($149-$349/month, $1,049 onboarding) conflict and are unverified; dropped. Sources disagree on whether xtraCHEF works without Toast POS; Toast positions it with Toast POS data. 'Accounting integration' carried from the current review, not re-verified. Website updated from toasttab.com/xtrachef to Toast's product page.
